title: cystopteris fragilis var. diaphana
intro: Cystopteris fragilis var. diaphana, commonly known as the delicate or fragile brittle fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Cystopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris fragilis var. diaphana include anti-edematous, anti-hemorrhagic, and anti-ulcerative properties, making it useful for treating various conditions like wounds, hemorrhages, and ulcers. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
